description: Scikit-learn text classification behind the OVOS pipeline API using the jurebes 'lda_classifier' baseline: TF-IDF word featurizer + Linear Discriminant Analysis.
model: lda_classifier (TF-IDF word featurizer + Linear Discriminant Analysis)
notes: Same engine as every other jurebes fighter, different featurizer x classifier recipe (registry baseline 'lda_classifier', group(s): discriminant); single-stage pipeline at the plugin's own medium-confidence gate. The arena measures which sklearn recipe wins on assistant-style templates, not which fighter 'is' jurebes.
